植物的哪一部分负责吸收水分？: Which part of a plant absorbs water?
根像小吸管，把土里的水喝进植物身体里。: Roots are like little straws that drink water from the soil into the plant.
我们用什么器官看东西？: Which organ do we use to see things?
眼睛像一台小照相机，把看到的画面传给大脑。: The eye is like a little camera that sends what it sees to the brain.
我们用什么器官闻气味？: Which organ do we use to smell?
鼻子里有很多“小侦探”，专门辨认各种气味。: The nose has many "little detectives" that recognise all kinds of smells.
我们用什么器官尝味道？: Which organ do we use to taste?
舌头上的味蕾能尝出酸、甜、苦、咸。: The taste buds on the tongue can taste sour, sweet, bitter and salty.
我们用什么器官听声音？: Which organ do we use to hear sounds?
声音钻进耳朵，大脑才知道那是什么声音。: Sound goes into the ear, and then the brain knows what the sound is.
植物的叶子主要用来做什么？: What are a plant's leaves mainly used for?
固定在地上: Fixing the plant to the ground
叶子是植物的“小厨房”，用阳光做饭。: Leaves are the plant's "little kitchen", cooking with sunlight.
下面哪种动物会飞？: Which of these animals can fly?
鸟有翅膀和羽毛，大多数会飞；青蛙、金鱼、乌龟不会飞。: Birds have wings and feathers and most can fly; frogs, goldfish and tortoises cannot.
鱼有鳃，能在水里呼吸，离开水就会憋坏啦。: Fish have gills and can breathe in water; out of water they cannot breathe.
鸡妈妈孵蛋大约 21 天，小鸡就啄破蛋壳出来了。: A hen sits on her eggs for about 21 days, and then the chicks peck their way out of the shell.
植物的种子可以长成什么？: What can a plant's seed grow into?
一粒小小的种子里，藏着一棵植物宝宝。: A tiny seed hides a baby plant inside.
下面哪种材料最容易被磁铁吸引？: Which material is most easily attracted by a magnet?
磁铁能吸住铁做的东西，吸不住塑料、木头和纸。: A magnet can pick up things made of iron, but not plastic, wood or paper.
把水倒进杯子，水的形状会怎样？: When you pour water into a cup, what happens to the shape of the water?
随杯子的形状变化: It changes with the shape of the cup
水是液体，没有固定的形状，倒进什么容器就变成什么形状。: Water is a liquid with no fixed shape; it takes the shape of whatever container it is poured into.
下面哪种材料是透明的？: Which of these materials is transparent?
玻璃让光线穿过去，所以窗户要用玻璃。: Glass lets light pass through, which is why windows are made of glass.
下面哪种材料最容易被水泡软？: Which material is most easily softened by soaking in water?
纸遇水会变软变烂，所以雨伞不用纸做。: Paper goes soft and falls apart in water, so umbrellas are not made of paper.
天气很冷时，水会结成什么？: When the weather is very cold, what does water turn into?
水冷到 0℃ 就会变成硬硬的冰。: When water cools to 0℃, it turns into hard ice.
太阳从哪个方向升起？: In which direction does the Sun rise?
太阳每天从东边升起，从西边落下。: The Sun rises in the east every day and sets in the west.
白天的光主要来自哪里？: Where does daytime light mainly come from?
太阳是离我们最近的恒星，给地球带来光和热。: The Sun is the star nearest to us and brings light and heat to the Earth.
光被物体挡住了: Light is blocked by an object
物体自己发光: The object gives out light itself
光是走直线的，被物体挡住后，后面就出现了影子。: Light travels in straight lines; when an object blocks it, a shadow appears behind the object.
一年有几个季节？: How many seasons are there in a year?
春、夏、秋、冬轮流来，一年有四个季节。: Spring, summer, autumn and winter come in turn, so there are four seasons in a year.
用来测量长度的工具是？: Which tool is used to measure length?
尺子上的刻度告诉我们物体有多长。: The marks on a ruler tell us how long an object is.
我们的国家叫中国，全称是中华人民共和国。: Our country is called China; its full name is the People's Republic of China.
中国的首都是哪里？: What is the capital of China?
北京: Song Yingxing wrote "Tiangong Kaiwu" (The Exploitation of the Works of Nature).
北京是中国的首都，著名的天安门就在那里。: Beijing is the capital of China, and the famous Tiananmen is there.
中国国旗上有几颗星？: How many stars are on the flag of China?
国旗上一颗大星、四颗小星，红色象征革命。: The flag has one big star and four small stars, and the red stands for revolution.
地球上的陆地和海洋，哪个面积更大？: On the Earth, which is bigger in area, land or ocean?
地球表面约七成是海洋，所以地球也叫“水球”。: About seventy percent of the Earth's surface is ocean, so the Earth is also called the "water planet".
下面哪种动物是中国的国宝？: Which of these animals is a national treasure of China?
大熊猫是中国特有的珍稀动物，最爱吃竹子。: The giant panda is a rare animal found only in China and loves to eat bamboo.
彩虹一般有几种颜色？: How many colours does a rainbow usually have?
彩虹是阳光被小水珠分开的颜色：红橙黄绿青蓝紫。: A rainbow is the colours of sunlight split by tiny water drops: red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue and violet.
饭前便后要做什么？: What should you do before meals and after using the toilet?
用肥皂洗手能洗掉细菌，就不容易生病。: Washing your hands with soap removes germs, so you are less likely to fall ill.
过马路时看到红灯应该怎么办？: What should you do when you see a red light while crossing the road?
红灯停，绿灯行，黄灯亮了等一等。: Red light, stop; green light, go; when the yellow light comes on, wait a moment.
每天刷牙，一般应该刷几次？: How many times a day should you usually brush your teeth?
早晚各一次: Once in the morning and once at night
早上和睡前各刷一次，牙齿就不容易长蛀虫。: Brush once in the morning and once before bed, and your teeth will not easily get cavities.
春节是在农历的哪一天？: On which day of the lunar calendar is the Spring Festival?
正月初一: The first day of the first lunar month
五月初五: The fifth day of the fifth lunar month
八月十五: The fifteenth day of the eighth lunar month
九月初九: The ninth day of the ninth lunar month
春节是中国最隆重的传统节日，一家人团团圆圆。: The Spring Festival is the grandest traditional festival in China, when the whole family gets together.
中秋节人们常吃什么？: What do people usually eat at the Mid-Autumn Festival?
中秋夜月亮圆，人们赏月、吃月饼，盼望团圆。: On Mid-Autumn night the Moon is round; people enjoy the Moon, eat mooncakes and hope for reunion.
端午节人们常吃什么？: What do people usually eat at the Dragon Boat Festival?
端午节吃粽子、赛龙舟，纪念爱国诗人屈原。: At the Dragon Boat Festival people eat zongzi and race dragon boats, in memory of the patriotic poet Qu Yuan.
磁铁有几个磁极？: How many magnetic poles does a magnet have?
每块磁铁都有 N 极和 S 极，把磁铁掰断，每一半还是有两个极。: Every magnet has an N pole and an S pole; if you break a magnet in two, each half still has two poles.
磁铁的同名磁极相互怎样？: How do like poles of magnets act on each other?
同极相斥、异极相吸，玩磁铁时可以亲手试一试。: Like poles repel and unlike poles attract; you can try it yourself with magnets.
下面哪个物体能被磁铁吸引？: Which of these objects can be attracted by a magnet?
铁钉是铁做的，能被磁铁吸住。: An iron nail is made of iron, so a magnet can pick it up.
水在多少摄氏度时结冰（标准大气压）？: At how many degrees Celsius does water freeze (at standard atmospheric pressure)?
水在 0℃ 结冰，所以冬天北方的湖面会变成冰面。: Water freezes at 0℃, so in winter lakes in the north turn to ice.
水沸腾时的温度约是（标准大气压）？: About what temperature does water boil at (at standard atmospheric pressure)?
水烧到 100℃ 就沸腾了，会冒出大量水蒸气。: When water is heated to 100℃ it boils and gives off lots of water vapour.
一杯水放进冰箱冷冻室变成冰，体积会怎样？: A cup of water is put in the freezer and turns to ice. What happens to its volume?
水结冰会变“胖”，所以装满水的瓶子冻住后会胀裂。: Water gets "fatter" when it freezes, so a bottle filled with water can burst when frozen.
糖放进水里慢慢不见了，这个现象叫什么？: Sugar put in water slowly disappears. What is this called?
糖分散成了小颗粒藏在水里，尝一尝水就变甜了。: The sugar breaks up into tiny particles hidden in the water, so the water tastes sweet.
蝴蝶的身体分为哪三部分？: Into which three parts is a butterfly's body divided?
昆虫的身体都分头、胸、腹三部分，蝴蝶是从毛毛虫变来的。: All insects have a body in three parts: head, thorax and abdomen; a butterfly changes from a caterpillar.
昆虫有几条腿？: How many legs does an insect have?
昆虫都有六条腿，蜘蛛有八条腿，所以蜘蛛不是昆虫。: All insects have six legs; a spider has eight legs, so a spider is not an insect.
哺乳动物的幼崽靠什么长大？: What do young mammals grow up on?
哺乳动物的妈妈用乳汁喂宝宝，比如猫、狗、鲸。: Mammal mothers feed their young with milk, such as cats, dogs and whales.
青蛙的幼体蝌蚪生活在哪里？: Where does the frog's young form, the tadpole, live?
蝌蚪用鳃呼吸，长大后长出四条腿，才上岸生活。: A tadpole breathes with gills and grows four legs as it matures before coming onto land.
鸟类的身体表面覆盖着什么？: What covers the body surface of birds?
羽毛能保暖，还能帮助飞行。: Feathers keep birds warm and also help them fly.
鱼用什么器官呼吸？: Which organ do fish use to breathe?
鱼把水吞进嘴里，让水流过鳃，鳃把水里的氧气吸收掉。: A fish takes water into its mouth and lets it flow over the gills, which absorb the oxygen in the water.
春、夏、秋、冬中，最热的季节是？: Among spring, summer, autumn and winter, which is the hottest season?
夏天太阳高，白天长，所以天气最热。: In summer the Sun is high and the days are long, so the weather is hottest.
一天中影子最短的时间大约在什么时候？: At about what time of day is a shadow shortest?
中午太阳最高，影子最短；早晚太阳低，影子长。: At noon the Sun is highest and shadows are shortest; morning and evening the Sun is low and shadows are long.
下面哪一种是水的固态？: Which of these is the solid state of water?
雪是水凝成的小冰晶，冰、雪、霜都是固态的水。: Snow is made of tiny ice crystals formed from water; ice, snow and frost are all solid water.
天气预报里的“多云”表示什么？: What does "cloudy" mean in a weather forecast?
天空中云比较多: There are quite a lot of clouds in the sky
一朵云也没有: There is not a single cloud
多云就是天空里有不少云，但太阳偶尔还能露脸。: Cloudy means there are quite a few clouds in the sky, but the Sun can still show its face now and then.
温度计是用来测量什么的？: What is a thermometer used to measure?
温度计里的红色液体会随温度升降，看刻度就知道冷热。: The red liquid in a thermometer rises and falls with temperature, so reading the scale tells you whether it is hot or cold.
天平（秤）是用来测量什么的？: What is a balance (scale) used to measure?
称一称就知道物体的质量，也就是有多“重”。: By weighing, you find the mass of an object, that is, how "heavy" it is.
量杯、量筒是用来测量什么的？: What are measuring cups and measuring cylinders used to measure?
量杯能告诉我们一杯水有多少毫升。: A measuring cup tells us how many millilitres of water are in a glass.
中国有多少个民族？: How many ethnic groups are there in China?
中国有 56 个民族，像一个大家庭，各有各的节日和服饰。: China has 56 ethnic groups, like one big family, each with its own festivals and clothing.
中国最长的河流是什么？: What is the longest river in China?
长江: The first emperor of the Tang Dynasty was Li Yuan, and its capital was Chang'an. The Tang was one of the strongest dynasties in Chinese history, and poetry flourished especially.
黄河: Which dynasty's first emperor was Li Yuan?
黑龙江: Shen Kuo wrote the science book "Dream Pool Essays".
长江全长约 6300 千米，是中国第一长河、世界第三长河。: The Yangtze is about 6,300 km long, the longest river in China and the third longest in the world.
被称为中华民族“母亲河”的是？: Which river is called the "Mother River" of the Chinese nation?
黄河孕育了古老的中华文明，因为河水泥沙多而呈黄色。: The Yellow River nurtured ancient Chinese civilisation and is yellow because the water carries so much silt.
世界上最高的山峰是什么？: What is the highest mountain in the world?
珠穆朗玛峰: Shakespeare was the British playwright who wrote "Hamlet".
富士山: Who was the Danish fairy-tale writer who wrote "The Little Match Girl"?
珠穆朗玛峰高约 8849 米，在中国和尼泊尔的边界上。: Mount Everest is about 8,849 metres high and lies on the border between China and Nepal.
地球上面积最大的海洋是什么？: What is the largest ocean on Earth?
太平洋面积大得能装下地球上所有的陆地还有富余。: The Pacific Ocean is so big that it could hold all the land on Earth with room to spare.
植物生长需要什么？: What do plants need to grow?
植物要晒太阳、喝水、呼吸空气，还要从土里吸收养分。: Plants need sunshine, water and air to breathe, and they take nutrients from the soil.
世界上最大的陆地动物是什么？: What is the largest land animal in the world?
非洲象体重可达六七吨，相当于好几辆小汽车。: An African elephant can weigh six or seven tonnes, as much as several small cars.
世界上最高的动物是什么？: What is the tallest animal in the world?
长颈鹿能长到五米多高，却只有七节颈椎，和人一样多。: A giraffe can grow more than five metres tall but has only seven neck bones, the same as a person.
被称为“沙漠之舟”的动物是什么？: Which animal is called the "ship of the desert"?
骆驼的驼峰能储存脂肪，让它在沙漠里很久不吃不喝。: A camel's hump stores fat, so it can go a long time in the desert without eating or drinking.
下面哪种动物冬天会冬眠？: Which of these animals hibernates in winter?
熊在冬天会长时间睡觉，靠体内储存的脂肪过冬。: Bears sleep for a long time in winter and live through it on the fat stored in their bodies.
发生火灾应该拨打哪个报警电话？: Which emergency number should you call in case of fire?
火警电话是 119，要说清楚地址，记得自己先跑到安全的地方。: The fire emergency number is 119; say clearly where you are, and remember to get to a safe place yourself first.
有人突然病重，需要急救应该拨打？: Which number should you call if someone suddenly becomes seriously ill and needs emergency help?
急救电话是 120，要说清楚地址和病人的情况。: The first-aid number is 120; say clearly the address and the patient's condition.
遇到坏人，需要警察帮助时拨打？: Which number should you call when you meet a bad person and need the police?
报警电话是 110，要沉着冷静，说清楚发生了什么事。: The police number is 110; stay calm and say clearly what has happened.
重阳节是农历的哪一天？: On which day of the lunar calendar is the Double Ninth Festival?
正月十五: The fifteenth day of the first lunar month
重阳节有登高、赏菊的习俗，也是敬老的节日。: The Double Ninth Festival has the customs of climbing high and enjoying chrysanthemums, and it is also a festival for honouring the elderly.
清明节人们常常做什么？: What do people usually do at the Qingming Festival?
扫墓、踏青: Sweep tombs and go on a spring outing
清明时节人们扫墓怀念亲人，也趁着春光去郊外踏青。: At Qingming people sweep tombs to remember their relatives, and also take a spring outing to the countryside.
空气看不见、摸不着，但风一吹，我们就知道它在那儿。: Air cannot be seen or touched, but when the wind blows we know it is there.
空气中大约占五分之一的气体是？: Which gas makes up about one fifth of the air?
氧气约占 21%，人和动物呼吸都靠它。: Oxygen makes up about 21%; people and animals depend on it to breathe.
空气中含量最多的气体是？: Which gas is the most plentiful in the air?
氮气约占 78%，是空气里最“大块头”的成员。: Nitrogen makes up about 78%, the biggest "heavyweight" in the air.
水有哪三种状态？: What are the three states of water?
水能变成冰、变成水、变成水蒸气，是自然界的“变形大师”。: Water can turn into ice, into liquid water and into water vapour, a "shape-shifting master" of nature.
水变成水蒸气的过程叫什么？: What is the process of water turning into water vapour called?
湿衣服晾干，就是衣服里的水蒸发到了空气中。: When wet clothes dry, the water in them evaporates into the air.
水蒸气遇冷变成小水珠的过程叫什么？: What is the process of water vapour turning into little water drops when it meets cold called?
冷饮杯外面的小水珠，就是空气里的水蒸气凝结成的。: The little drops on the outside of a cold drink glass are water vapour from the air that has condensed.
冰变成水的过程叫什么？: What is the process of ice turning into water called?
冰受热会融化，雪人遇到太阳就变小了。: Ice melts when heated; a snowman gets smaller in the Sun.
声音是由物体的什么产生的？: What are sounds produced by in an object?
用手摸着喉咙说话，能感觉到振动；鼓面上的小米粒会跳起来。: If you touch your throat while speaking you can feel the vibration; millet grains on a drum skin jump up.
声音在下面哪种物质中传播得最快？: In which of these does sound travel fastest?
声音在固体中传得最快，听火车可以把耳朵贴在铁轨上。: Sound travels fastest in solids; to listen for a train you can put your ear against the rail.
太空是真空，所以宇航员在太空中要靠无线电说话。: Space is a vacuum, so astronauts must talk by radio in space.
植物的种子萌发需要什么条件？: What conditions does a plant seed need to germinate?
适量的水分、空气和适宜的温度: A suitable amount of water, air and a suitable temperature
种子发芽要有水、空气和合适的温度，不一定需要阳光。: Seeds need water, air and a suitable temperature to sprout; they do not necessarily need sunlight.
植物的叶片通过什么作用制造养料？: Through which process do a plant's leaves make nutrients?
光合作用是植物用阳光、水和二氧化碳制造养料，还放出氧气。: In photosynthesis plants use sunlight, water and carbon dioxide to make nutrients and also give off oxygen.
蚕的一生要经历哪几个阶段？: Which stages does a silkworm go through in its life?
蚕宝宝先吃桑叶长大，再吐丝结茧，变成蛹，最后变成蛾。: A baby silkworm first eats mulberry leaves and grows, then spins silk to make a cocoon and becomes a pupa, and finally turns into a moth.
一株植物的哪一部分最先从种子里长出来？: Which part of a plant comes out of the seed first?
种子发芽时，根最先钻出来，向下扎进土里。: When a seed sprouts, the root comes out first and goes down into the soil.
月球本身会发光吗？: Does the Moon itself give out light?
会，自己发光: Yes, it gives out its own light
月亮像一面大镜子，反射着太阳的光才亮起来。: The Moon is like a big mirror; it shines because it reflects sunlight.
月相变化的周期大约是多久？: About how long is the cycle of the phases of the Moon?
月亮从圆到缺再到圆，大约一个月，这就是“月”这个时间单位的来历。: The Moon goes from round to a crescent and back to round in about a month, which is where the time unit "month" comes from.
农历十五前后的月亮通常是什么样子？: What does the Moon usually look like around the fifteenth of the lunar month?
农历每月十五前后月亮最圆，中秋节的月亮就是满月。: Around the fifteenth of each lunar month the Moon is roundest; the Moon at the Mid-Autumn Festival is a full moon.
地球表面大约有多少被水覆盖？: About how much of the Earth's surface is covered by water?
从太空看，地球是一颗蓝色的星球，因为海洋占了大部分。: Seen from space, the Earth is a blue planet because oceans cover most of it.
使物体向下落的是什么力？: What force makes objects fall downward?
苹果落地、水往低处流，都是地球的引力（重力）在拉着它们。: Apples falling to the ground and water flowing downhill are both pulled by the Earth's gravity.
测量一杯水的体积应该用什么？: What should you use to measure the volume of a glass of water?
量筒上有刻度，倒进水后看水面对应的刻度就知道有多少毫升。: A measuring cylinder has a scale; after pouring in the water, read the mark at the water surface to know how many millilitres there are.
地球上有几个大洲？: How many continents are there on the Earth?
亚洲、欧洲、非洲、北美洲、南美洲、大洋洲、南极洲，一共七个。: Asia, Europe, Africa, North America, South America, Oceania and Antarctica: seven in all.
世界上面积最大的洲是哪个？: Which is the largest continent in the world by area?
亚洲: A German composer who still wrote the "Fifth Symphony" after going deaf
非洲: Who collected and edited "Grimms' Fairy Tales"?
欧洲: Who painted the "Mona Lisa" and was a Renaissance all-rounder?
南美洲: Leonardo da Vinci painted the "Mona Lisa" and was a Renaissance all-rounder.
亚洲面积最大，人口也最多，中国就在亚洲。: Asia has the largest area and the most people, and China is in Asia.
中国面积最大的省级行政区是哪里？: Which province-level division of China has the largest area?
新疆: His fleet completed the first voyage around the world
青海: What is Zhuge Liang known for?
新疆面积约 166 万平方千米，占中国国土面积的六分之一。: Xinjiang covers about 1.66 million square kilometres, one sixth of China's land area.
下面哪个城市不是直辖市？: Which of these cities is not a municipality directly under the central government?
重庆: Oversaw the building of the Jingzhang Railway, designed by Chinese engineers
中国的直辖市只有北京、天津、上海、重庆四个。: China has only four municipalities directly under the central government: Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai and Chongqing.
中国古代四大发明中，用来指引方向的是？: Of the Four Great Inventions of ancient China, which one was used to show direction?
指南针让航海家在茫茫大海上也不迷路。: The compass lets sailors find their way even on the vast sea.
改进造纸术的蔡伦是哪个朝代的人？: Cai Lun, who improved papermaking, lived in which dynasty?
东汉蔡伦改进了造纸术，让纸成了便宜好用的书写材料。: Cai Lun of the Eastern Han improved papermaking, making paper a cheap and handy material for writing.
世界上最大的鸟是什么？: What is the largest bird in the world?
鸵鸟身高可达两米多，不会飞，但跑起来飞快。: An ostrich can be over two metres tall; it cannot fly, but it runs very fast.
世界上跑得最快的陆地动物是什么？: What is the fastest land animal in the world?
猎豹冲刺时速能超过 100 千米，比大多数汽车在城市里还快。: A cheetah can sprint at more than 100 kilometres an hour, faster than most cars in a city.
地球上最大的动物是什么？: What is the largest animal on Earth?
蓝鲸长约 30 米，比三辆公共汽车连起来还长。: A blue whale is about 30 metres long, longer than three buses in a row.
均衡饮食的好习惯是什么？: What is a good habit for a balanced diet?
荤素搭配、不挑食: Eat both meat and vegetables, and do not be picky
肉、蛋、奶、蔬菜、水果都吃一点，身体才长得棒。: Eat a bit of meat, eggs, milk, vegetables and fruit, and the body will grow strong.
看书写字时，眼睛离书本大约多远合适？: When reading and writing, about how far should the eyes be from the book?
保持“一尺一拳一寸”：眼离书一尺，胸离桌一拳，手离笔尖一寸。: Keep to "one foot, one fist, one inch": eyes one foot from the book, chest one fist from the desk, hand one inch from the pen tip.
要让小灯泡亮起来，电路必须怎样？: For a small bulb to light up, what must the circuit be like?
形成闭合的回路: It must form a closed loop
没有电池也行: It works even without a battery
电流要沿着一个圈走回电池，路断了灯就不亮。: The current has to go round a loop back to the battery; if the path is broken, the bulb does not light.
一个完整的简单电路至少需要什么？: What does a complete simple circuit need at least?
电源、导线、用电器: A power source, wires and an electrical device
电源、导线、用电器缺一不可，再加开关就能控制它。: A power source, wires and an electrical device are all needed; add a switch and you can control it.
下面哪种材料是导体？: Which of these materials is a conductor?
金属都善于导电，所以电线里面是铜丝。: Metals all conduct electricity well, so there is copper wire inside electric cables.
下面哪种材料是绝缘体？: Which of these materials is an insulator?
塑料、橡胶不导电，所以电线外面包着塑料皮保护我们。: Plastic and rubber do not conduct electricity, so electric wires are covered in plastic to protect us.
电路中开关的作用是什么？: What is the function of a switch in a circuit?
控制电路的通断: To open and close the circuit
开关一断开，电路就断了，灯就灭了。: When the switch is opened, the circuit is broken and the light goes out.
电池在电路中的作用是什么？: What is the function of a battery in a circuit?
控制通断: To open and close the circuit
电池是电路的“动力”，把化学能变成电能。: A battery is the "power" of the circuit and turns chemical energy into electrical energy.
影响糖在水里溶解快慢的因素有哪些？: What factors affect how fast sugar dissolves in water?
热水里糖化得更快，搅一搅也更快。: Sugar dissolves faster in hot water, and faster when stirred.
面粉放进水里搅拌后静置，会怎样？: What happens when flour is stirred into water and left to stand?
慢慢沉到底部，不溶解: It slowly sinks to the bottom and does not dissolve
面粉不溶于水，放久了会慢慢沉淀到杯底。: Flour does not dissolve in water; left for a while it slowly settles at the bottom of the cup.
声音的高低叫做什么？: What is the highness or lowness of a sound called?
琴弦越短越紧，声音越高；这就是音调。: The shorter and tighter a string is, the higher the sound; this is pitch.
声音的强弱（大小）叫做什么？: What is the strength (loudness) of a sound called?
用力敲鼓，鼓面振动幅度大，声音就响。: When you hit a drum hard, the drum skin vibrates with a big swing and the sound is loud.
食物在人体内消化吸收的主要场所是？: What is the main place where food is digested and absorbed in the human body?
小肠又细又长，是吸收营养的“主力”。: The small intestine is thin and long and is the "main force" for absorbing nutrients.
食物的消化是从哪里开始的？: Where does the digestion of food begin?
咀嚼时唾液里的消化液已经开始分解淀粉，所以米饭越嚼越甜。: While chewing, the digestive juice in saliva has already started to break down starch, so rice tastes sweeter the more you chew.
人体的哪个器官主要负责呼吸？: Which organ of the human body is mainly in charge of breathing?
我们有左右两个肺，像两个会鼓起来的小气球。: We have a left and a right lung, like two little balloons that swell up.
植物的茎主要有什么作用？: What is the main function of a plant's stem?
输送水分和养料，支撑植物: To carry water and nutrients and support the plant
茎像“高速公路”，运送水和养分，还撑起整棵植物。: The stem is like a "motorway", carrying water and nutrients and also holding up the whole plant.
岩石按形成原因分为哪三大类？: Into which three main groups are rocks divided by the way they form?
岩浆冷却成岩浆岩，沉积物压实成沉积岩，高温高压改变成变质岩。: Magma cools into igneous rock, sediment pressed together forms sedimentary rock, and high heat and pressure change rock into metamorphic rock.
古代生物留下的遗体或遗迹: The remains or traces left by ancient living things
化石是石头里的“时间胶囊”，告诉我们几亿年前的生命是什么样。: A fossil is a "time capsule" in rock that tells us what life was like hundreds of millions of years ago.
土壤的组成里一般不包括下面哪一项？: Which of these is not generally part of soil?
土壤里有沙粒、黏土、腐殖质、水和空气，没有金属铁块。: Soil contains sand grains, clay, humus, water and air, but no lumps of iron.
想把小物体放大了看，可以用什么工具？: Which tool can you use to look at a small object enlarged?
放大镜是凸透镜，能把小东西“放大”，观察昆虫和叶脉很方便。: A magnifying glass is a convex lens that can "enlarge" small things, which is handy for looking at insects and leaf veins.
中国面积最大的岛屿是哪个？: Which is the largest island of China?
台湾岛面积约 3.6 万平方千米，是中国第一大岛。: Taiwan Island covers about 36,000 square kilometres and is the largest island of China.
中国最大的淡水湖是哪个？: Which is the largest freshwater lake in China?
鄱阳湖在江西，是中国最大的淡水湖，冬天是候鸟的天堂。: Poyang Lake is in Jiangxi and is the largest freshwater lake in China; in winter it is a paradise for migratory birds.
中国最大的咸水湖是哪个？: Which is the largest salt lake in China?
青海湖是中国最大的咸水湖，湖水又咸又涩，湖里有湟鱼。: Qinghai Lake is the largest salt lake in China; its water is salty and bitter, and it holds the Huang fish (naked carp).
世界上流量最大的河流是哪条？: Which river in the world has the greatest flow?
亚马孙河的水量约占全世界河流入海总水量的五分之一。: The Amazon carries about one fifth of all the water that rivers of the world pour into the sea.
被称为“世界屋脊”的是哪里？: Which place is called the "Roof of the World"?
青藏高原平均海拔 4000 米以上，是世界上最高的高原。: The Qinghai-Tibet Plateau averages over 4,000 metres above sea level and is the highest plateau in the world.
万里长城最初主要是为了什么而修建？: What was the Great Wall originally built mainly for?
防御北方民族的侵扰: To defend against raids by northern peoples
长城是古人防御外敌入侵的大工程，绵延上万里。: The Great Wall was a huge project by ancient people to defend against invaders, stretching for thousands of miles.
中国历史上第一个统一的中央集权国家是哪个朝代？: Which dynasty was the first unified, centralised state in Chinese history?
秦始皇统一了文字、度量衡和货币，影响了两千多年。: Qin Shi Huang unified writing, weights and measures and currency, with effects lasting more than two thousand years.
唐朝的首都长安在今天的哪座城市？: In which city of today was Chang'an, the capital of the Tang Dynasty?
唐朝的长安是当时世界上最大的城市之一，就在今天的西安。: Tang Dynasty Chang'an was one of the biggest cities in the world at the time, and it is today's Xi'an.
郑和下西洋发生在哪个朝代？: In which dynasty did Zheng He's voyages to the Western Seas take place?
明朝的郑和七次下西洋，船队比当时欧洲的船大得多。: Zheng He of the Ming Dynasty made seven voyages to the Western Seas, with ships much bigger than the European ships of the time.
下面哪种动物以长寿著称？: Which of these animals is famous for living a long time?
有些乌龟能活一百多岁，甚至更久。: Some tortoises can live for over a hundred years, or even longer.
蜜蜂靠什么告诉同伴蜜源的位置？: How do bees tell their companions where the nectar source is?
蜜蜂用“8 字舞”告诉同伴花在哪个方向、有多远。: Bees use the "figure-eight dance" to tell their companions in which direction the flowers are and how far.
蝙蝠属于哪一类动物？: What kind of animal is the bat?
蝙蝠是唯一会飞的哺乳动物，靠发出超声波辨别方向。: The bat is the only mammal that can fly, and it uses the ultrasound it gives out to tell direction.
发生地震时，在室内应该怎么做？: What should you do indoors during an earthquake?
躲到坚固的桌子下或墙角，保护头部: Hide under a sturdy table or in a corner of a wall and protect your head
马上乘电梯下楼: Take the lift down at once
跳窗逃走: Escape by jumping out of a window
站在窗边看: Stand by the window and watch
躲在坚固的桌子下或墙角，用手护住头，不要乘电梯。: Hide under a sturdy table or in a corner of a wall, cover your head with your hands, and do not take the lift.
发现有人触电，首先应该做什么？: When you find someone has had an electric shock, what should you do first?
直接用手去拉: Pull the person directly by hand
先切断电源，或用干木棍挑开电线，千万别直接用手拉人。: First cut off the power, or use a dry wooden stick to push the wire away; never pull the person directly by hand.
光在同一种均匀的介质中沿什么路线传播？: Along what path does light travel in a single uniform medium?
光沿直线传播，所以小孔能成倒立的像，影子边缘也是清晰的。: Light travels in straight lines, so a small hole makes an upside-down image and the edges of shadows are sharp.
光从空气斜射入水中，传播方向会怎样？: When light passes obliquely from air into water, what happens to its direction?
插在水里的筷子看起来“折断”了，就是光的折射。: A chopstick placed in water looks "broken"; this is the refraction of light.
平面镜成像利用的是光的什么现象？: Which property of light does a plane mirror use to form images?
照镜子时，光被镜面反射回我们眼睛，才看见了自己。: When you look in a mirror, light is reflected from the mirror back into your eyes, and that is how you see yourself.
白光通过三棱镜后会被分解成什么？: What is white light split into after it passes through a prism?
牛顿用三棱镜发现，白光其实是七色光混合成的。: Using a prism, Newton found that white light is actually a mixture of seven colours of light.
热总是从哪里传向哪里？: In which direction does heat always travel?
温度高的物体传向温度低的物体: From a hotter object to a cooler one
温度低的传向温度高的: From a cooler one to a hotter one
大的传向小的: From a larger one to a smaller one
热会从热的物体传向冷的物体，所以热汤会慢慢变凉。: Heat passes from a hot object to a cold one, so hot soup slowly cools down.
热的传递有哪三种方式？: What are the three ways heat is transferred?
勺子烫手是传导，空气上升是对流，晒太阳暖烘烘是辐射。: A spoon that burns your hand is conduction, rising air is convection, and feeling warm in the Sun is radiation.
下面哪种材料传热最快？: Which of these materials conducts heat fastest?
金属传热快，所以锅是金属做的，锅柄却用塑料或木头。: Metals conduct heat quickly, so pans are made of metal while pan handles are made of plastic or wood.
摩擦力的大小与什么有关？: What does the size of friction depend on?
接触面的粗糙程度和压力大小: How rough the contact surfaces are and how hard they are pressed together
天气的好坏: Whether the weather is good or bad
接触面越粗糙、压得越紧，摩擦力就越大。: The rougher the contact surface and the harder it is pressed, the greater the friction.
下面哪种做法能增大摩擦？: Which of these actions increases friction?
鞋底有花纹、轮胎有纹路，都是为了增大摩擦防滑。: Shoe soles have patterns and tyres have treads, all to increase friction and prevent slipping.
地球自转一周大约需要多长时间？: About how long does the Earth take to spin once on its axis?
地球自转一周约 24 小时，就是一天，带来白天和黑夜。: The Earth spins once in about 24 hours, which is one day, bringing day and night.
地球绕太阳公转一周大约需要多长时间？: About how long does the Earth take to go once around the Sun?
地球绕太阳转一圈约 365 天，就是一年。: The Earth goes once around the Sun in about 365 days, which is one year.
昼夜交替是由什么引起的？: What causes the alternation of day and night?
地球一边自转，一边被太阳照亮一半，所以有白天和黑夜。: As the Earth spins, half of it is lit by the Sun, so there is day and night.
四季变化主要是因为什么？: What are the changes of the seasons mainly due to?
地球公转，并且地轴是倾斜的: The Earth's revolution, together with the tilt of its axis
太阳忽冷忽热: The Sun getting hot and cold
地球绕太阳转，地轴是歪着的，所以太阳光直射的位置会变化。: The Earth goes round the Sun with its axis tilted, so the place where sunlight falls straight down keeps changing.
地球的形状大致是什么？: What is the shape of the Earth, roughly?
地球是一个两极稍扁、赤道稍鼓的球体。: The Earth is a sphere slightly flattened at the poles and slightly bulging at the equator.
在食物链“草→兔→狼”中，草属于什么？: In the food chain "grass → rabbit → wolf", what is the grass?
植物能自己制造养料，是食物链的起点。: Plants can make their own nutrients and are the start of a food chain.
蘑菇、细菌能分解动植物遗体，它们属于什么？: Mushrooms and bacteria can break down the remains of animals and plants. What are they?
分解者把遗体变回泥土里的养分，让大自然循环起来。: Decomposers turn remains back into nutrients in the soil, keeping nature's cycle going.
一个生态系统包括哪些部分？: What parts does an ecosystem include?
生物和它们生活的环境: Living things and the environment they live in
生物和它们生活的环境合在一起，才组成一个生态系统。: Living things and their environment together make up an ecosystem.
把物体放入水中，它是沉还是浮，取决于什么？: When an object is put into water, whether it sinks or floats depends on what?
它受到的浮力和重力的大小: The sizes of the buoyant force and the weight acting on it
它的软硬: How soft or hard it is
浮力大于重力就上浮，小于就下沉；大铁船能浮是因为排开了很多水。: If buoyancy is greater than weight it rises, and if smaller it sinks; a big iron ship floats because it pushes aside a lot of water.
弹簧测力计是用来测量什么的？: What is a spring balance (newton meter) used to measure?
弹簧被拉得越长，说明力越大。: The more the spring is stretched, the greater the force.
力的单位是什么？: What is the unit of force?
力的单位牛顿是为了纪念科学家牛顿，一个苹果大约重 1 牛。: The unit of force, the newton, is named after the scientist Newton; an apple weighs about 1 newton.
中国的省级行政区一共有多少个？: How many province-level divisions are there in China?
中国有 34 个省级行政区：23 个省、5 个自治区、4 个直辖市、2 个特别行: China has 34 province-level divisions: 23 provinces, 5 autonomous regions, 4 municipalities and 2 special administrative regions.
中国人口最多的民族是什么？: Which ethnic group has the largest population in China?
汉族人口最多，其他 55 个民族称为少数民族。: The Han have the largest population; the other 55 ethnic groups are called ethnic minorities.
亚洲与欧洲的分界山脉是哪个？: Which mountain range separates Asia from Europe?
乌拉尔山脉: What is Florence Nightingale known for?
喜马拉雅山脉: Florence Nightingale was the founder of modern nursing.
阿尔卑斯山脉: Kepler put forward the three laws of planetary motion.
乌拉尔山脉像一道南北走向的“分界线”。: The Ural Mountains are like a north-south "dividing line".
地球仪上赤道的纬度是多少？: What is the latitude of the equator on a globe?
赤道是纬度 0° 的那条线，也是地球上最长的纬线。: The equator is the line at latitude 0° and is also the longest line of latitude on the Earth.
北半球是冬季的时候，南半球是什么季节？: When it is winter in the northern hemisphere, what season is it in the southern hemisphere?
南北半球季节相反，北半球过春节时，澳大利亚正过暑假。: The seasons are opposite in the two hemispheres; when the north celebrates the Spring Festival, Australia is on summer holiday.
《论语》主要记录了谁的言行？: Whose words and deeds are mainly recorded in the "Analects"?
《论语》记录了孔子和弟子的话，里面有“学而时习之”。: The "Analects" records the words of Confucius and his disciples, including the line "to learn and practise it in time".
开辟“丝绸之路”的汉代使者是谁？: Who was the Han Dynasty envoy who opened up the "Silk Road"?
张骞两次出使西域，打通了东西方交流的大道。: Zhang Qian was sent twice to the Western Regions and opened a great route of exchange between East and West.
中华人民共和国成立于哪一年？: In which year was the People's Republic of China founded?
1949 年 10 月 1 日，中华人民共和国在北京成立。: On 1 October 1949 the People's Republic of China was founded in Beijing.
中国共产党成立于哪一年？: In which year was the Communist Party of China founded?
1921 年 7 月，中国共产党在上海召开第一次全国代表大会。: In July 1921 the Communist Party of China held its first National Congress in Shanghai.
世界上最大的热带沙漠是哪个？: Which is the largest tropical desert in the world?
撒哈拉沙漠面积约 900 万平方千米，差不多和中国一样大。: The Sahara covers about 9 million square kilometres, almost as big as China.
下面哪种能源是可再生能源？: Which of these energy sources is renewable?
太阳能用不完，煤和石油要亿万年才能形成，用一点少一点。: Solar energy never runs out, while coal and oil take hundreds of millions of years to form, so the more we use, the less is left.
废旧电池属于哪一类垃圾？: What kind of waste is used batteries?
电池里有重金属，乱扔会污染土壤和水，要放进有害垃圾箱。: Batteries contain heavy metals; thrown away carelessly they pollute soil and water, so put them in the hazardous waste bin.
植物光合作用需要吸收什么气体？: Which gas does a plant take in for photosynthesis?
植物吸进二氧化碳，放出氧气，是地球的“空气净化器”。: Plants take in carbon dioxide and give off oxygen, making them the Earth's "air purifiers".
缺乏维生素 A 容易引起什么病？: What illness is easily caused by a lack of vitamin A?
胡萝卜、动物肝脏含维生素 A，多吃对眼睛好。: Carrots and animal liver contain vitamin A; eating more of them is good for the eyes.
电灯发光时，电能主要转化为什么能？: When an electric light shines, into which energy is electrical energy mainly turned?
灯泡发光也会发热，所以用久了会烫手。: A bulb that shines also gives off heat, so it gets hot to the touch after a long time.
杠杆的三个要素是什么？: What are the three elements of a lever?
支点、动力、阻力：跷跷板就是最常见的杠杆。: Fulcrum, effort and resistance: a seesaw is the most common lever.
定滑轮的作用是什么？: What is the function of a fixed pulley?
改变力的方向: To change the direction of the force
旗杆顶上的滑轮，让我们往下拉绳，旗子却向上升。: A pulley at the top of a flagpole lets us pull the rope down while the flag goes up.
动滑轮的作用是什么？: What is the function of a movable pulley?
一点不省力: It saves no effort at all
动滑轮能省力，但要多拉一段绳子。: A movable pulley saves effort, but you have to pull a longer length of rope.
剪刀、撬棍都是什么简单机械？: Scissors and crowbars are all which simple machine?
这些工具都是杠杆，能让我们更省力或者更方便。: These tools are all levers, which make our work easier or more convenient.
食物中储存的能量最初来自哪里？: Where does the energy stored in food originally come from?
植物用阳光做养料，动物吃植物，能量最初都来自太阳。: Plants make nutrients with sunlight and animals eat plants, so the energy originally all comes from the Sun.
显微镜下看到的生物体基本结构单位是什么？: What is the basic structural unit of living things seen under a microscope?
1665 年胡克用显微镜看软木片，第一次看到了“细胞”。: In 1665 Hooke looked at a slice of cork under a microscope and saw "cells" for the first time.
植物细胞有、而动物细胞没有的结构是？: Which structure do plant cells have but animal cells do not?
细胞壁像一层“硬壳”，让植物能挺立起来。: The cell wall is like a "hard shell" that lets plants stand upright.
生物的遗传物质主要存在于细胞的哪里？: Where in the cell is the genetic material of living things mainly found?
细胞核是细胞的“指挥中心”，里面有遗传信息。: The nucleus is the "command centre" of the cell and holds the genetic information.
达尔文进化论的核心观点是什么？: What is the core idea of Darwin's theory of evolution?
自然选择、适者生存: Natural selection, survival of the fittest
适应环境的生物更容易活下来，慢慢就进化成现在的样子。: Living things that fit their environment survive more easily, and slowly evolve into what they are today.
恐龙生活在哪个地质时代？: In which geological era did the dinosaurs live?
恐龙统治地球一亿多年，约 6600 万年前大部分灭绝了。: Dinosaurs ruled the Earth for more than a hundred million years, and most died out about 66 million years ago.
食物腐败变质主要是由什么引起的？: What mainly causes food to rot and go bad?
冰箱里温度低，细菌繁殖得慢，食物才能保存更久。: The low temperature in a fridge makes bacteria multiply slowly, so food keeps longer.
太阳系中最大的行星是什么？: What is the largest planet in the solar system?
木星大得能装下一千三百多个地球。: Jupiter is so big it could hold more than thirteen hundred Earths.
离太阳最近的行星是什么？: Which planet is nearest to the Sun?
水星离太阳最近，白天很热，夜晚很冷。: Mercury is nearest to the Sun; it is very hot by day and very cold at night.
太阳系有几大行星？: How many major planets does the solar system have?
水、金、地、火、木、土、天王、海王，一共八颗。: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus and Neptune: eight in all.
太阳是一颗什么天体？: What kind of celestial body is the Sun?
太阳是一颗会自己发光发热的恒星，地球绕着它转。: The Sun is a star that gives out its own light and heat, and the Earth goes round it.
月球是地球的什么？: What is the Moon to the Earth?
月球是地球唯一的天然卫星，绕着地球转。: The Moon is the Earth's only natural satellite and goes round the Earth.
“光年”是什么单位？: What kind of unit is a "light-year"?
光一年走的距离叫一光年，约 9.46 万亿千米，用来量恒星间的距离。: The distance light travels in a year is called a light-year, about 9.46 trillion kilometres, and is used to measure distances between stars.
三角形结构在工程中常被使用，是因为它的什么特点？: Triangular structures are often used in engineering because of which characteristic?
三角形不容易变形，所以桥梁、塔吊、自行车架都有三角形。: A triangle does not easily change shape, so bridges, tower cranes and bicycle frames all have triangles.
蒸汽机的广泛使用开启了什么？: What did the widespread use of the steam engine begin?
蒸汽机让工厂、火车和轮船动起来，推动了工业革命。: The steam engine set factories, trains and ships moving and drove the Industrial Revolution.
中国地势的总体特点是什么？: What is the general character of China's terrain?
西高东低，呈三级阶梯: High in the west, low in the east, in three steps
东高西低: High in the east, low in the west
南高北低: High in the south, low in the north
北高南低: High in the north, low in the south
西高东低，所以中国的大河大多从西向东流入大海。: It is high in the west and low in the east, so most of China's big rivers flow from west to east into the sea.
联合国总部设在哪座城市？: In which city is the headquarters of the United Nations?
联合国总部在美国纽约，是各国协商世界大事的地方。: The United Nations headquarters is in New York, USA, where countries discuss world affairs.
世界上人口最多的洲是哪个？: Which continent has the most people in the world?
亚洲人口约占世界总人口的六成。: Asia has about sixty percent of the world's population.
地球上热带、温带、寒带的划分主要依据什么？: What is the division of the Earth into tropical, temperate and frigid zones mainly based on?
太阳光热的分布（纬度）: The distribution of the Sun's light and heat (latitude)
越靠近赤道，阳光越直，越热；越靠近两极，越冷。: The nearer the equator, the more directly the sunlight falls and the hotter it is; the nearer the poles, the colder it is.
人类第一个登上月球的是谁？: Who was the first person to land on the Moon?
1969 年，阿姆斯特朗在月球上留下了第一个脚印。: In 1969 Armstrong left the first footprint on the Moon.
中国第一位进入太空的航天员是谁？: Who was the first Chinese astronaut to enter space?
2003 年，杨利伟乘神舟五号飞船在太空绕地球飞了 14 圈。: In 2003 Yang Liwei flew round the Earth 14 times in space aboard the Shenzhou 5 spacecraft.
电话的发明者通常认为是谁？: Who is generally considered the inventor of the telephone?
1876 年贝尔发明了电话，让远方的人也能说话。: In 1876 Bell invented the telephone, so that people far away could talk to each other.
改良蒸汽机、推动工业革命的是谁？: Who improved the steam engine and drove the Industrial Revolution?
瓦特改良了蒸汽机，让机器的力量大大提高。: Watt improved the steam engine and greatly increased the power of machines.
提出万有引力定律的科学家是谁？: Which scientist put forward the law of universal gravitation?
传说牛顿看到苹果落地，想到了月亮为什么不掉下来。: Legend says that Newton saw an apple fall and wondered why the Moon does not fall.
提出“日心说”的天文学家是谁？: Which astronomer put forward the heliocentric theory?
哥白尼提出太阳是中心，地球等行星绕着太阳转。: Copernicus proposed that the Sun is the centre and that the Earth and other planets go round it.
被誉为“杂交水稻之父”的科学家是谁？: Which scientist is honoured as the "Father of Hybrid Rice"?
袁隆平培育的杂交水稻让更多人吃饱了饭。: The hybrid rice that Yuan Longping bred means more people have enough to eat.
因发现青蒿素而获得诺贝尔奖的中国科学家是谁？: Which Chinese scientist won the Nobel Prize for discovering artemisinin?
屠呦呦发现青蒿素，挽救了全世界数百万疟疾患者。: Tu Youyou discovered artemisinin and saved millions of malaria patients around the world.
地球大气层中的臭氧层主要作用是什么？: What is the main function of the ozone layer in the Earth's atmosphere?
吸收太阳的紫外线: To absorb the Sun's ultraviolet rays
臭氧层像一把“防晒伞”，挡住了大部分有害的紫外线。: The ozone layer is like a "sunshade" that blocks most of the harmful ultraviolet rays.
造成温室效应的主要气体是什么？: Which gas is the main cause of the greenhouse effect?
二氧化碳像一床“被子”，让地球变暖，所以要节能减排。: Carbon dioxide is like a "blanket" that warms the Earth, so we need to save energy and cut emissions.
人体最大的器官是什么？: What is the largest organ of the human body?
皮肤像一件“外衣”，保护身体，还能感觉冷热。: The skin is like a "coat" that protects the body and can feel heat and cold.
人体血液循环的动力器官是什么？: Which organ drives the circulation of blood in the human body?
心脏像一个水泵，不停地把血液送到全身。: The heart is like a pump that keeps sending blood to the whole body.
速度的公式是什么？: What is the formula for speed?
速度 = 路程 ÷ 时间：骑 2 小时走 30 千米，速度就是 15 千米/时。: Speed = distance ÷ time: cycling 30 km in 2 hours gives a speed of 15 km/h.
1 m/s 等于多少 km/h？: How many km/h is 1 m/s equal to?
1 米/秒 = 3.6 千米/时，所以 10 米/秒的短跑速度就是 36 千米/: 1 m/s = 3.6 km/h, so a sprint speed of 10 m/s is 36 km/h.
声音在空气中（15℃）的传播速度约是多少？: About how fast does sound travel in air (at 15℃)?
打雷时先看到闪电后听到雷声，因为光比声音快得多。: In a thunderstorm you see lightning first and hear thunder later, because light is much faster than sound.
光在真空中的传播速度约是多少？: About how fast does light travel in a vacuum?
光一秒钟能绕地球赤道转 7 圈半，是宇宙中最快的速度。: In one second light can go round the Earth's equator seven and a half times, the fastest speed in the universe.
光的反射定律：反射角和入射角的关系是？: Law of reflection of light: what is the relation between the angle of reflection and the angle of incidence?
反射角等于入射角: The angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence
反射角大于入射角: The angle of reflection is greater than the angle of incidence
反射角小于入射角: The angle of reflection is less than the angle of incidence
从镜子里看自己，光路是对称的：反射角等于入射角。: Looking at yourself in a mirror, the path of light is symmetrical: the angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence.
平面镜所成的像是什么样的？: What kind of image does a plane mirror form?
正立、等大的虚像: An upright virtual image of the same size
镜子里的像是左右颠倒、大小相等的虚像，摸不着。: The image in a mirror is a virtual image of equal size, reversed left to right, that cannot be touched.
物距大于二倍焦距时，凸透镜成什么像？: When the object distance is greater than twice the focal length, what image does a convex lens form?
照相机就是这样成像的：倒立、缩小的实像。: A camera forms its image in just this way: an inverted, reduced real image.
水的凝固点是多少（标准大气压）？: What is the freezing point of water (at standard atmospheric pressure)?
水在 0℃ 结冰，加了盐的水要更冷才会结冰，所以冬天路上撒盐能化雪。: Water freezes at 0℃; salt water has to be colder to freeze, so sprinkling salt on the road in winter melts snow.
物质从固态直接变成气态叫什么？: What is it called when a substance changes directly from a solid to a gas?
樟脑丸、干冰会直接“消失”，是升华成了气体。: Mothballs and dry ice seem to "disappear" directly, because they sublimate into a gas.
物质从气态直接变成固态叫什么？: What is it called when a substance changes directly from a gas to a solid?
冬天窗户上的冰花，就是水蒸气直接凝华成的小冰晶。: The frost patterns on a window in winter are tiny ice crystals formed when water vapour turns directly into solid.
冰（晶体）熔化的过程中，温度怎样？: What happens to the temperature while ice (a crystal) is melting?
冰在熔化时不停吸热，但温度一直保持 0℃，直到全部化成水。: While ice melts it keeps taking in heat, but the temperature stays at 0℃ until it has all turned to water.
测量长度的基本工具是什么？: What is the basic tool for measuring length?
刻度尺读数要估读到最小刻度的下一位。: When reading a ruler, estimate to one place beyond the smallest division.
质量的国际单位是什么？: What is the SI unit of mass?
质量用千克表示，不论带到月球还是地球，质量不变。: Mass is given in kilograms; whether taken to the Moon or the Earth, the mass does not change.
密度的公式是什么？: What is the formula for density?
密度 = 质量 ÷ 体积：一块铁比同样大小的木头重，因为铁的密度大。: Density = mass ÷ volume: a piece of iron is heavier than wood of the same size because iron has a greater density.
水的密度是多少？: What is the density of water?
水的密度约 1 克/立方厘米，1 升水就是 1 千克。: The density of water is about 1 g/cm³, so 1 litre of water is 1 kilogram.
声音的三个特性是什么？: What are the three characteristics of sound?
我们能分辨是谁在说话，靠的是音色。: We can tell who is speaking by timbre.
人耳能听到的声音频率范围大约是？: About what range of sound frequencies can the human ear hear?
小狗能听到更高频率的声音，所以狗哨人听不见、狗能听见。: A puppy can hear sounds of higher frequency, so a dog whistle cannot be heard by people but can be heard by dogs.
超声波是指频率怎样的声波？: What kind of sound wave is an ultrasonic wave?
蝙蝠和海豚靠超声波“看”东西，医院也用它做 B 超。: Bats and dolphins "see" with ultrasound, and hospitals use it for ultrasound scans.
生物体结构和功能的基本单位是什么？: What is the basic unit of structure and function in living things?
除了病毒，所有生物都由细胞构成。: All living things except viruses are made of cells.
显微镜的放大倍数等于什么？: What is the magnification of a microscope equal to?
目镜 10× 加物镜 40×，总共放大 400 倍。: An eyepiece of 10× with an objective of 40× gives 400 times magnification in all.
植物光合作用的场所是什么？: Where does photosynthesis take place in plants?
叶绿体里有叶绿素，让叶子变成绿色，也是做“饭”的车间。: Chloroplasts contain chlorophyll, which makes leaves green and is also the workshop where the "meal" is made.
地球赤道的周长大约是多少？: About how long is the Earth's circumference at the equator?
赤道一圈约 4 万千米，所以一米的定义最初就是子午线长度的四千万分之一。: The equator is about 40,000 km round, so the metre was originally defined as one forty-millionth of the length of a meridian.
经线指示什么方向？: Which direction do lines of longitude show?
经线连接南北两极，指示南北方向；纬线指示东西方向。: Lines of longitude join the North and South Poles and show north-south; lines of latitude show east-west.
人体消化食物、吸收营养的主要器官是？: What is the main organ of the human body for digesting food and absorbing nutrients?
小肠又细又长（约 5～6 米），内壁有很多小突起，吸收面积特别大。: The small intestine is thin and long (about 5 to 6 metres) and has many tiny projections on its inner wall, giving it a very large surface for absorption.
绿色植物叶片上负责气体交换和散失水分的结构是？: Which structure on the leaves of green plants handles gas exchange and loses water?
一片叶子上有成千上万个气孔，像小嘴巴一样一张一合。: A leaf has thousands upon thousands of stomata, which open and close like little mouths.
在食物链“草→鼠→蛇→鹰”中，数量通常最少的是？: In the food chain "grass → mouse → snake → eagle", which is usually the fewest in number?
能量沿食物链逐级减少，所以处在越高位置的生物数量越少。: Energy decreases step by step along a food chain, so the higher up an organism is, the fewer there are.
人体的血液由什么组成？: What is human blood made of?
红细胞运氧气，白细胞抵御细菌，血小板帮助止血。: Red blood cells carry oxygen, white blood cells fight bacteria, and platelets help stop bleeding.
蝌蚪发育成青蛙的过程叫什么？: What is the process of a tadpole developing into a frog called?
蝌蚪用鳃呼吸，长成青蛙后改用肺和皮肤呼吸。: A tadpole breathes with gills; once grown into a frog it breathes with lungs and skin instead.
哺乳动物的主要特征是什么？: What are the main features of mammals?
胎生、哺乳: Live birth and feeding young with milk
体温随环境变化: Body temperature changes with the surroundings
哺乳动物体温恒定，宝宝在妈妈肚子里长大并吃奶。: Mammals keep a steady body temperature; their babies grow inside the mother and drink milk.
经度的起点（0°）是哪条经线？: Which line of longitude is the starting point (0°) of longitude?
本初子午线经过英国伦敦格林尼治天文台旧址。: The prime meridian passes through the old Royal Observatory at Greenwich in London, England.
纬度的起点（0°）是哪条线？: Which line is the starting point (0°) of latitude?
赤道把地球分成南北两个半球。: The equator divides the Earth into a northern and a southern hemisphere.
地球上终年炎热的温度带是？: Which temperature zone of the Earth is hot all year round?
热带在南北回归线之间，太阳几乎直射，所以终年炎热。: The tropical zone lies between the Tropic of Cancer and the Tropic of Capricorn, where the Sun is almost overhead, so it is hot all year.
全球陆地一共分为几个大洲？: Into how many continents is all the world's land divided?
亚洲、欧洲、非洲、北美洲、南美洲、大洋洲、南极洲。: Asia, Europe, Africa, North America, South America, Oceania and Antarctica.
世界上最大的大洋是？: What is the largest ocean in the world?
太平洋面积接近全世界海洋总面积的一半。: The Pacific Ocean covers nearly half of the total area of all the world's oceans.
第一个用望远镜观察天空，发现木星卫星的科学家是？: Which scientist was the first to watch the sky with a telescope and discover the moons of Jupiter?
1609 年起伽利略用望远镜发现了木星的四颗大卫星。: From 1609 Galileo used a telescope to discover Jupiter's four large moons.
东汉科学家张衡发明了什么？: What did the Eastern Han scientist Zhang Heng invent?
张衡的地动仪是世界上最早的地震探测仪器之一。: Zhang Heng's seismoscope was one of the earliest earthquake-detecting instruments in the world.
南北朝时的祖冲之在数学上的重要成就是？: What was the important mathematical achievement of Zu Chongzhi of the Northern and Southern Dynasties?
把圆周率精确到小数点后第七位: Calculated pi accurately to the seventh decimal place
他算出圆周率在 3.1415926 与 3.1415927 之间，领先世界近一千: He worked out that pi lies between 3.1415926 and 3.1415927, nearly a thousand years ahead of the world.
传说阿基米德发现浮力原理时喊出了什么？: Legend says that when Archimedes discovered the principle of buoyancy, what did he shout?
传说他洗澡时看见水溢出来，一下悟出了测王冠体积的办法。: Legend says that while taking a bath he saw the water spill over and suddenly realised how to measure the volume of the crown.
引起海水涨落（潮汐）的主要天体是？: Which celestial body mainly causes the rising and falling of the sea (the tides)?
月球对海水的引力最明显，所以潮水有涨有落。: The Moon's gravity on the sea is the most noticeable, so the tide rises and falls.
雨后出现彩虹，是因为阳光发生了什么？: When a rainbow appears after rain, what has happened to the sunlight?
阳光穿过小水珠被分成七色，所以雨后常见彩虹。: Sunlight passes through tiny water drops and is split into seven colours, so rainbows are often seen after rain.
重力的公式是什么？: What is the formula for weight (gravity)?
重力 = 质量 × g：一个 50 千克的人，在地球上约重 500 牛。: Weight = mass × g: a person of 50 kg weighs about 500 N on the Earth.
g 约等于多少？: About what is g equal to?
在月球上 g 只有地球的六分之一，所以宇航员能跳得很高。: On the Moon g is only one sixth of that on the Earth, so astronauts can jump very high.
牛顿第一定律：不受力时物体保持什么状态？: Newton's first law: what state does an object keep when no force acts on it?
静止或匀速直线运动: At rest or in uniform motion in a straight line
公交车突然刹车，我们会向前倾，就是因为惯性。: When a bus brakes suddenly we lean forward, because of inertia.
惯性的大小由什么决定？: What determines the size of inertia?
质量越大，惯性越大，所以大卡车比小汽车更难刹住。: The greater the mass, the greater the inertia, so a big lorry is harder to stop than a small car.
二力平衡的条件是什么？: What are the conditions for two forces to balance?
大小相等、方向相反、作用在同一物体同一直线上: Equal in size, opposite in direction, acting on the same object along the same line
大小相等、方向相同: Equal in size and in the same direction
大小不等、方向相反: Unequal in size and opposite in direction
桌上的书静止不动，是因为重力和支持力是一对平衡力。: A book on a table stays still because its weight and the supporting force are a pair of balanced forces.
压强的公式是什么？: What is the formula for pressure?
压强 = 压力 ÷ 受力面积：同样的力，面积越小压强越大。: Pressure = force ÷ area: for the same force, the smaller the area, the greater the pressure.
压强的单位是什么？: What is the unit of pressure?
压强单位帕斯卡很小，1 帕只相当于一张纸平铺在桌面上的压强。: The pascal is a very small unit; 1 Pa is only the pressure of a sheet of paper lying flat on a table.
减小受力面积或增大压力: Reduce the area or increase the force
减小物体重量: Reduce the weight of the object
刀口要磨得很薄，就是为了减小受力面积、增大压强。: A knife edge is ground very thin in order to reduce the contact area and increase the pressure.
液体内部压强的公式是什么？: What is the formula for the pressure inside a liquid?
越往深处压强越大，所以水坝下面要修得比上面厚。: The deeper you go, the greater the pressure, so a dam is built thicker at the bottom than at the top.
阿基米德原理：物体受到的浮力等于什么？: Archimedes' principle: the buoyant force on an object equals what?
它排开的液体受到的重力: The weight of the liquid it displaces
液体的总重力: The total weight of the liquid
浮力等于排开液体的重力，这就是为什么大轮船能浮在水上。: Buoyancy equals the weight of the liquid displaced, which is why big ships can float on water.
浮力的公式是什么？: What is the formula for buoyancy?
浮力大小取决于液体密度和物体排开液体的体积。: Buoyancy depends on the density of the liquid and the volume of liquid the object displaces.
物体漂浮在液面时，浮力和重力的关系是？: When an object floats on a liquid surface, what is the relation between buoyancy and weight?
漂浮的物体处于平衡状态，浮力恰好等于它的重力。: A floating object is in balance, and the buoyancy is exactly equal to its weight.
功的公式是什么？: What is the formula for work?
功 = 力 × 在力的方向上移动的距离：提着东西不动，对东西不做功。: Work = force × distance moved in the direction of the force: holding something without moving does no work on it.
功率的公式是什么？: What is the formula for power?
功率表示做功的快慢，同样的活儿，功率大的机器干得快。: Power shows how fast work is done; for the same job, a machine with more power does it faster.
功率的单位是什么？: What is the unit of power?
瓦特是为了纪念改良蒸汽机的科学家瓦特。: The watt is named in memory of the scientist Watt, who improved the steam engine.
杠杆的平衡条件是什么？: What is the condition for a lever to balance?
动力 × 动力臂 = 阻力 × 阻力臂，小朋友坐得离支点远些就能压起大人。: Effort × effort arm = resistance × resistance arm; a child sitting farther from the fulcrum can lift up an adult.
使用一个动滑轮（不计摩擦和滑轮重）最多可以省多少力？: Using one movable pulley (ignoring friction and the pulley's weight), how much effort can be saved at most?
动滑轮相当于省力杠杆，只需要一半的力，但要多拉一倍的绳子。: A movable pulley is like a lever that saves effort: it needs only half the force, but you have to pull twice the length of rope.
机械效率总是怎样的？: What is the efficiency of a machine always like?
使用机械总要克服摩擦，额外功不可避免，所以效率总小于 1。: Using a machine always means overcoming friction, so extra work is unavoidable and the efficiency is always less than 1.
一个标准大气压约等于多少？: About how much is one standard atmosphere equal to?
1 标准大气压约 10 万帕，相当于 10 米高水柱产生的压强。: One standard atmosphere is about 100,000 Pa, equal to the pressure of a column of water 10 metres high.
常用液体温度计是利用液体的什么性质制成的？: On which property of liquids is the common liquid thermometer based?
液体受热膨胀、遇冷收缩，所以温度计里的液柱会升降。: A liquid expands when heated and contracts when cooled, so the liquid column in a thermometer rises and falls.
同种电荷之间的相互作用是什么？: What is the interaction between charges of the same kind?
头发被梳子梳过会竖起来，是因为头发带上了同种电荷互相排斥。: Hair stands up after being combed because it has taken on charges of the same kind that repel each other.
电流的单位是什么？: What is the unit of electric current?
安培是为了纪念法国物理学家安培。: The ampere is named in memory of the French physicist Ampère.
电压的单位是什么？: What is the unit of voltage?
伏特是为了纪念发明电池的意大利物理学家伏特。: The volt is named in memory of the Italian physicist Volta, who invented the battery.
电阻的单位是什么？: What is the unit of resistance?
欧姆是为了纪念德国物理学家欧姆，他发现了欧姆定律。: The ohm is named in memory of the German physicist Ohm, who discovered Ohm's law.
串联电路中各处的电流有什么关系？: What is the relation between the currents at different points in a series circuit?
等于各处之和: Equal to the sum of the currents
串联像一条单行道，电流只有一条路，所以处处相等。: A series circuit is like a one-way street: the current has only one path, so it is the same everywhere.
并联电路中各支路两端的电压有什么关系？: What is the relation between the voltages across the branches of a parallel circuit?
等于各支路电压之和: Equal to the sum of the branch voltages
家里的电器都是并联的，每个都得到 220 伏。: The appliances at home are all in parallel, so each gets 220 volts.
光合作用的产物是什么？: What are the products of photosynthesis?
植物把二氧化碳和水变成有机物，还放出我们呼吸需要的氧气。: Plants turn carbon dioxide and water into organic matter and also give off the oxygen we need to breathe.
遗传物质 DNA 主要在细胞的哪里？: Where in the cell is the genetic material DNA mainly found?
DNA 像一本“说明书”，决定了我们的长相和性状。: DNA is like an "instruction manual" that decides our looks and traits.
孟德尔通过豌豆杂交实验发现了什么？: What did Mendel discover through his pea cross-breeding experiments?
他种了多年豌豆，被称为“遗传学之父”。: He grew peas for many years and is called the "father of genetics".
正常人体细胞中有多少条染色体？: How many chromosomes are there in a normal human body cell?
每个人从爸爸、妈妈那里各得到 23 条染色体。: Each person gets 23 chromosomes from the father and 23 from the mother.
细胞进行呼吸作用的主要场所是？: What is the main place where cells carry out respiration?
线粒体被称为细胞的“动力工厂”。: Mitochondria are called the "power plants" of the cell.
人体血液循环的中心器官是？: What is the central organ of blood circulation in the human body?
心脏一天大约要跳 10 万次。: The heart beats about 100,000 times a day.
生态系统中能量的最终来源是？: What is the ultimate source of energy in an ecosystem?
植物把阳光变成养分，再沿着食物链传给动物。: Plants turn sunlight into nutrients, which are then passed on to animals along the food chain.
中国地势的总体特点是？: What is the general character of China's terrain?
所以中国的大河大多自西向东流入海洋。: So most of China's big rivers flow from west to east into the ocean.
中国面积最大的平原是？: What is the largest plain in China?
东北平原土壤肥沃，盛产大豆、玉米，被称为“北大仓”。: The Northeast Plain has fertile soil and produces plenty of soybeans and maize; it is called the "great granary of the north".
中国最大的盆地是？: What is the largest basin in China?
塔里木盆地中间是塔克拉玛干沙漠。: In the middle of the Tarim Basin is the Taklamakan Desert.
中国南方和北方的分界线大致是？: About where is the dividing line between southern and northern China?
这条线以北种小麦、吃面食多，以南种水稻、吃米饭多。: North of this line wheat is grown and more wheat foods are eaten; south of it rice is grown and more rice is eaten.
湖水含盐极高、人能漂浮在水面上的“死海”位于哪个大洲？: On which continent is the "Dead Sea", whose water is so salty that people can float on it?
死海在以色列和约旦之间，也是陆地上海拔最低的地方之一。: The Dead Sea lies between Israel and Jordan and is also one of the lowest places on land.
提出相对论的科学家是谁？: Which scientist put forward the theory of relativity?
爱因斯坦说，时间和空间并不是绝对不变的。: Einstein said that time and space are not absolute and unchanging.
这一发现让发电机成为可能，人类进入了电气时代。: This discovery made the generator possible, and humanity entered the age of electricity.
《天工开物》的作者是谁？: Who wrote "Tiangong Kaiwu" (The Exploitation of the Works of Nature)?
这本书记录了明代的农业和手工业技术，被称为“工艺百科全书”。: This book records agricultural and handicraft techniques of the Ming Dynasty and is called the "encyclopedia of crafts".
《本草纲目》的作者是谁？: Who wrote "Compendium of Materia Medica" (Bencao Gangmu)?
李时珍花了近三十年，记录了近两千种药物。: Li Shizhen spent nearly thirty years recording nearly two thousand medicines.
酸雨主要由哪类气体引起？: Which kind of gases mainly cause acid rain?
酸雨会腐蚀建筑，也会伤害森林和湖泊里的生物。: Acid rain corrodes buildings and also harms the living things in forests and lakes.
下面哪种做法有利于节约能源？: Which of these actions helps save energy?
随手关灯、少开车: Switching off lights when leaving and driving less
夏天空调开到 16℃: Setting the air conditioner to 16℃ in summer
手机一直插着充电: Leaving a phone plugged in to charge all the time
小习惯汇在一起，就是大大的节约。: Small habits add up to big savings.
欧姆定律的公式是什么？: What is the formula of Ohm's law?
电压越大电流越大，电阻越大电流越小：I = U / R。: The greater the voltage, the greater the current; the greater the resistance, the smaller the current: I = U / R.
电功率的公式是什么？: What is the formula for electric power?
电功率 = 电压 × 电流，100 瓦的灯泡比 20 瓦的更亮。: Electric power = voltage × current; a 100 W bulb is brighter than a 20 W one.
焦耳定律的公式是什么？: What is the formula of Joule's law?
电流通过电阻会发热，电饭锅、电热水壶就是利用这个原理。: A current passing through a resistance produces heat; rice cookers and electric kettles use this principle.
串联电路的总电阻是多少？: What is the total resistance of a series circuit?
串联相当于增加了导体的长度，所以总电阻变大。: Connecting in series is like making the conductor longer, so the total resistance becomes larger.
并联电路总电阻的公式是什么？: What is the formula for the total resistance of a parallel circuit?
并联相当于增加了导体的横截面积，总电阻比任何一个都小。: Connecting in parallel is like making the conductor's cross-section larger, so the total resistance is smaller than any single one.
比热容的物理意义是什么？: What is the physical meaning of specific heat capacity?
单位质量的某种物质温度升高 1℃ 吸收的热量: The heat absorbed by a unit mass of a substance when its temperature rises by 1℃
物体吸收热量的多少: How much heat an object absorbs
物体的温度高低: How high or low an object's temperature is
比热容大的物质吸热多、升温慢，所以海边昼夜温差比沙漠小。: A substance with a large specific heat capacity absorbs more heat and warms up slowly, so the day-night temperature range by the sea is smaller than in a desert.
水的比热容约是多少？: About what is the specific heat capacity of water?
水的比热容很大，所以暖气里用热水来输送热量。: Water has a very large specific heat capacity, so hot water is used in radiators to carry heat.
物体吸收热量的公式是什么？: What is the formula for the heat absorbed by an object?
Q = cmΔt：质量越大、升温越多，需要的热量就越多。: Q = cmΔt: the greater the mass and the greater the rise in temperature, the more heat is needed.
内燃机四个冲程中，对外做功的是哪个？: Of the four strokes of an internal combustion engine, which one does work on the outside?
汽油机的四个冲程是吸气、压缩、做功、排气，只有做功冲程让车动起来。: The four strokes of a petrol engine are intake, compression, power and exhaust; only the power stroke makes the car move.
通电导线周围存在磁场，这一现象是谁发现的？: A current-carrying wire has a magnetic field around it; who discovered this?
1820 年奥斯特在课堂上偶然发现通电导线能让小磁针偏转。: In 1820 Oersted discovered by chance in a lesson that a current-carrying wire can make a small magnetic needle turn.
发电机的工作原理是什么？: What is the working principle of a generator?
通电导体在磁场中受力: A current-carrying conductor feels a force in a magnetic field
电流的热效应: The heating effect of electric current
电流的磁效应: The magnetic effect of electric current
线圈在磁场里转动，就会产生电流，这就是发电机。: When a coil turns in a magnetic field, a current is produced; this is a generator.
电动机的工作原理是什么？: What is the working principle of an electric motor?
通电的线圈在磁场里会受力转动，电风扇、洗衣机里都有电动机。: A current-carrying coil feels a force in a magnetic field and turns; electric fans and washing machines have motors.
我国家庭电路的电压是多少？: What is the voltage of household circuits in China?
家庭电路是 220 伏，所以不能用手去摸插座。: Household circuits are 220 volts, so you must not touch a socket with your hands.
对人体安全的电压不高于多少？: What is the highest voltage that is safe for the human body?
不高于 36 伏的电压对人体是安全的，手机充电器输出只有几伏。: A voltage of no more than 36 volts is safe for the human body; a phone charger outputs only a few volts.
保持水的化学性质的最小粒子是什么？: What is the smallest particle that keeps the chemical properties of water?
水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子构成，所以水是 H₂O。: A water molecule is made of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom, so water is H₂O.
原子核和核外电子: A nucleus and the electrons outside it
原子很小很小，中间是带正电的原子核，外面有电子绕着转。: Atoms are very, very small, with a positively charged nucleus in the middle and electrons going round outside.
空气中氧气的体积分数约是多少？: About what is the volume fraction of oxygen in the air?
空气里约五分之一是氧气，所以点燃蜡烛罩上杯子，它很快会熄灭。: About one fifth of the air is oxygen, so if you light a candle and cover it with a glass, it soon goes out.
空气中氮气的体积分数约是多少？: About what is the volume fraction of nitrogen in the air?
氮气化学性质不活泼，食品包装里常充氮气防腐。: Nitrogen is chemically unreactive, so food packaging is often filled with nitrogen to prevent spoilage.
实验室加热固体制取氧气常用什么药品？: In the laboratory, which substance is commonly heated to make oxygen from a solid?
加热高锰酸钾可以得到氧气，试管口要放一团棉花防止粉末进入导管。: Heating potassium permanganate gives oxygen; a plug of cotton wool is put at the mouth of the test tube to keep powder out of the delivery tube.
怎样检验氧气？: How do you test for oxygen?
氧气能助燃，带火星的木条伸进去会重新燃烧起来。: Oxygen supports burning; a glowing splint put into it will burst into flame again.
检验二氧化碳通常用什么？: What is usually used to test for carbon dioxide?
二氧化碳能让澄清石灰水变浑浊，这是最经典的检验方法。: Carbon dioxide makes clear limewater turn cloudy, the classic way to test for it.
实验室制取二氧化碳用什么药品？: Which substances are used to make carbon dioxide in the laboratory?
碳酸钠和稀硫酸: Sodium carbonate and dilute sulfuric acid
大理石（主要成分是碳酸钙）遇到稀盐酸会冒出大量气泡。: Marble (mainly calcium carbonate) gives off lots of bubbles when it meets dilute hydrochloric acid.
铁生锈需要接触什么？: What must iron be in contact with to rust?
铁同时接触氧气和水才会生锈，所以给自行车上油、刷漆可以防锈。: Iron rusts only when it touches oxygen and water at the same time, so oiling or painting a bicycle prevents rust.
酸遇到紫色石蕊试液会变成什么颜色？: What colour does an acid turn purple litmus solution?
紫甘蓝汁也能当酸碱指示剂：遇酸变红，遇碱变蓝绿。: Purple cabbage juice can also be used as an acid-base indicator: red with acid, blue-green with base.
碱遇到无色酚酞试液会变成什么颜色？: What colour does a base turn colourless phenolphthalein solution?
无色酚酞遇碱变红，遇酸不变色。: Colourless phenolphthalein turns red with a base and does not change colour with an acid.
pH 小于 7 的溶液呈什么性？: What kind of solution has a pH below 7?
pH 小于 7 是酸性，等于 7 是中性，大于 7 是碱性；柠檬汁的 pH 大约: A pH below 7 is acidic, equal to 7 is neutral, above 7 is basic; the pH of lemon juice is about 2.
酸和碱发生中和反应，生成什么？: When an acid and a base undergo a neutralisation reaction, what is produced?
胃酸过多时吃碱性药片，就是利用中和反应。: Taking an alkaline tablet when there is too much stomach acid uses a neutralisation reaction.
下列金属中活动性最强的是？: Which of these metals is the most reactive?
钾的活动性很强，丢进水里会剧烈反应，实验室要把它放在煤油里。: Potassium is very reactive and reacts violently when dropped in water, so in the laboratory it is kept in paraffin oil.
下列金属能与稀盐酸反应放出氢气的是？: Which of these metals reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to give off hydrogen?
位于氢前面的金属才能置换出酸里的氢，锌可以，铜、银、金不行。: Only metals above hydrogen can displace the hydrogen from an acid; zinc can, but copper, silver and gold cannot.
水通电分解时，正极产生什么气体？: When water is split by electric current, which gas is produced at the positive electrode?
电解水时负极得氢气、正极得氧气，体积比约 2 : 1。: In the electrolysis of water, hydrogen is obtained at the negative electrode and oxygen at the positive electrode, in a volume ratio of about 2 : 1.
水通电分解时，氢气与氧气的体积比约是多少？: When water is split by electric current, what is the volume ratio of hydrogen to oxygen?
水（H₂O）里氢原子数是氧原子数的 2 倍，所以氢气体积是氧气的 2 倍。: Water (H₂O) has twice as many hydrogen atoms as oxygen atoms, so the volume of hydrogen is twice that of oxygen.
元素周期表中的一横行叫什么？: What is a horizontal row in the periodic table called?
元素周期表一共有 7 个横行，也就是 7 个周期。: The periodic table has 7 horizontal rows, that is, 7 periods.
元素周期表中的一纵列（主族）叫什么？: What is a vertical column (main group) in the periodic table called?
同一族的元素化学性质相似，比如钠和钾都很活泼。: Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties; for example, sodium and potassium are both very reactive.
下列属于氧化物的是哪个？: Which of these is an oxide?
氧化物是由两种元素组成、其中一种是氧元素的化合物，二氧化碳就是氧化物。: An oxide is a compound made of two elements, one of which is oxygen; carbon dioxide is an oxide.
化学反应前后一定不变的是什么？: What definitely stays the same before and after a chemical reaction?
原子的种类和数目: The kinds and number of atoms
化学反应只是原子重新组合，原子种类和数目都不会变。: A chemical reaction only rearranges atoms; the kinds and number of atoms do not change.
质量守恒定律：参加反应的各物质质量总和与生成的各物质质量总和有什么关系？: Law of conservation of mass: what is the relation between the total mass of the substances that react and the total mass of the substances produced?
拉瓦锡在密闭容器里加热金属，用天平证明了反应前后总质量不变。: Lavoisier heated a metal in a sealed container and proved with a balance that the total mass did not change before and after the reaction.
地壳中含量最多的元素是什么？: What is the most abundant element in the Earth's crust?
地壳中最多的是氧，其次是硅，所以沙子、岩石的主要成分都含硅和氧。: Oxygen is the most abundant in the Earth's crust, followed by silicon, so sand and rock mainly contain silicon and oxygen.
氢气比空气轻得多，所以氢气球能飞上天，但它容易爆炸，现在多用氦气。: Hydrogen is much lighter than air, so hydrogen balloons can fly up, but it explodes easily, so helium is mostly used now.
物种多样性、遗传多样性、生态系统多样性: Species diversity, genetic diversity, ecosystem diversity
保护生物多样性，就是保护我们自己的家园。: Protecting biodiversity means protecting our own home.
达尔文进化论认为生物进化的主要原因是？: According to Darwin's theory of evolution, what is the main cause of evolution of living things?
适应环境的个体更容易生存并留下后代，慢慢地物种就变化了。: Individuals that fit their environment survive more easily and leave offspring, and slowly the species changes.
抗生素主要用来对付什么？: What are antibiotics mainly used against?
普通感冒大多是病毒引起的，抗生素没用，不要乱吃。: Ordinary colds are mostly caused by viruses; antibiotics do not help, so do not take them without need.
接种疫苗的作用是什么？: What is the function of a vaccination?
让身体提前产生抵抗某种病的免疫力: To let the body build immunity to a disease in advance
天花就是靠疫苗在全球被消灭的。: Smallpox was wiped out worldwide by means of vaccines.
人体的胰岛素由什么分泌？: By which organ is the human body's insulin secreted?
胰岛素能降低血糖，缺乏会引起糖尿病。: Insulin can lower blood sugar; a lack of it causes diabetes.
光合作用的原料是什么？: What are the raw materials of photosynthesis?
光合作用把光能变成了储存在有机物里的化学能。: Photosynthesis turns light energy into chemical energy stored in organic matter.
世界上面积最大的国家是？: Which is the largest country in the world by area?
俄罗斯横跨欧亚大陆，国内有 11 个时区。: Russia spans Europe and Asia and has 11 time zones within it.
世界上人口最多的国家（近年）是？: Which country has the largest population in the world (in recent years)?
据联合国统计，印度在 2023 年人口超过中国。: According to the United Nations, India's population passed China's in 2023.
板块构造学说认为，地震、火山多发生在哪里？: According to plate tectonics, where do earthquakes and volcanoes mostly occur?
环太平洋地带地震、火山频繁，被称为“火圈”。: The Pacific Rim has frequent earthquakes and volcanoes and is called the "Ring of Fire".
赤道不经过下面哪个大洲？: The equator does not pass through which of these continents?
赤道经过非洲、南美洲和亚洲（印度尼西亚）。: The equator passes through Africa, South America and Asia (Indonesia).
地中海气候的特点是什么？: What are the features of the Mediterranean climate?
夏季炎热干燥、冬季温和多雨: Hot, dry summers and mild, rainy winters
地中海沿岸的橄榄、葡萄在这种气候下长得特别好。: Olives and grapes along the Mediterranean grow especially well in this climate.
发现元素周期律的科学家是谁？: Which scientist discovered the periodic law of the elements?
他把元素按原子量排列，还准确预言了当时没发现的元素。: He arranged the elements by atomic mass and also accurately predicted elements not yet discovered at the time.
两次获得诺贝尔奖的女科学家是谁？: Which woman scientist won the Nobel Prize twice?
她发现了钋和镭，分别获得物理学奖和化学奖。: She discovered polonium and radium and won the prize in physics and the prize in chemistry.
